usedFor: Vectara holds your search corpora, and Google Drive gets a document through “Create a new sheet or doc or slide”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Corpora Created” in Vectara, then “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new corpus gets a document in Drive where you can note its purpose.

watchOut: “Delete File” permanently deletes a Drive file, so do not attach it to “New Corpora Created”.
